title: Create: Nations & Frontiers
description: Build factories, explore a transformed world, and forge your own nation with Create-powered automation. Progress through exploration, industry, and expansion as you carve out your place in the frontier.
body:
Build your own nation with your friends, powered by Create.

Minecraft 1.21.1  •  NeoForge  •  Multiplayer-focused

--- ## About this Pack This Modpack is all about founding **Nations** with your friends. Focused around the **Create Mod**, you start with a single workshop and grow it into a full nation factories, railways, airships, and an economy of your own. On top of base Create is a huge list of addons: electricity with **Create Crafts & Additions** and **Create: Power Grid**, rail networks with **Steam 'n' Rails** and **Create: Tracks+**, airships with **Create Aeronautics**, and a full currency system with shops and a stock market through **Create: Numismatics**. **CC: Tweaked** is included for running your machines with code. Built to be played with others. **Open Parties and Claims** lets you claim and protect your land, and **Plasmo Voice** adds proximity voice chat for diplomacy, trade, and everything in between. The world is overhauled with **Terralith** and **Incendium**, and **Dungeons and Taverns** rebuilds the vanilla structures worth digging through. **Xaero's Minimap** keeps you from getting lost. When borders get contested, the engineering turns bloody **Create Big Cannons**, **Create: Gunsmithing**, **Superb Warfare**, and **Create: The Air War** for fighting from the deck of an airship. Tuned for performance with **Sodium** and **Lithium**, plus full shader support through **Iris**. There are plenty more mods inside to round things out food, decoration, building blocks, and more.
